transcript_text: Some commercial properties in Singapore are bought $300,000 to $500,000 below market value. But the real question is, how do you actually identify them? Most investors only look at price. What I focus on is the numbers behind the property. In some commercial deals I've done, the purchase price was already hundreds of thousands below market value when entering. The key isn't fun. It's understanding how to evaluate the true market value, the exit strategy, and the numbers that determine whether the deal actually makes sense. These aren't theories. The deals I've personally done and frameworks we've shared with others. If you are interested to understand how we evaluate these opportunities, I'll be breaking it down in the session.
